metadata_issues.before: Los casos siguen documentos públicos; no se inventan participantes ni experiencias individuales. Se distinguen acusaciones, decisiones, compromisos de reparación, explicaciones empresariales e interpretación del autor. Cada ensayo indica su alcance histórico y los límites de sus fuentes. El informe de investigación ayudó a seleccionar los casos; no sustituye los documentos originales citados ni sus límites probatorios. Esta reescritura completa parte del ensayo chino publicado; no ofrece asesoramiento jurídico o empresarial vigente ni una actualización automática de los procedimientos.

post_application.application: Applied only the 28 individually approved exact before-to-after replacements using apply_patch. No global regex formatting was used, and the original full Spanish cross-review report was not modified.
post_application.actual_saved_prose_read: Retrieved and actually reread all 28 affected complete saved fields: 19 source titles, eight source notes and the Apple historical source_note. The date and citation-list spaces read naturally.
post_application.preservation: No wording, date, amount, decimal comma, source ID, URL, body argument or historical scope changed. All specified after strings were verified in their exact saved fields.

scope_note_review.conclusion: Retrieved the three complete saved fields, not just replacement strings. The English-independent-writing and complete Chinese-script notices are natural and accurate. PetSmart now clearly attributes denial of liability to the company and non-adjudication of fact/law issues to the settlement, without claiming an exonerating judgment. Existing historical cutoffs, evidence and non-advice limits remain intact.

browser_note_review.reviewer: Independent non-author reader of the two saved Japanese Thames note fields
actual_fields_read: Chinese thames-water historical_note_zh and sources[4].note_zh in full
browser_note_review.conclusion: The saved Japanese is natural and faithful: fundraising is explicitly financial, the article retains the 2025-08-27 cutoff and separate company/regulatory/author statements, sewage enforcement does not settle drinking-water or separate criminal inquiries, and the remaining 80 percent follows the earliest of three payment deadlines rather than three purportedly earliest conditions. The backstop and non-receipt/non-follow-up limitations remain clear.

limits: The first 28 entries are exact source-metadata whitespace changes. Three additional entries preserve original-edition scope in the Spanish/Japanese collection notes and attribute PetSmart's denial to the company rather than the agreement. Two final Japanese Thames source-note fields clarify financing and the earliest of three payment deadlines in natural sentences. All were independently read after saving; full prose reviews remain separately recorded.
